scraped_content.main_text: Double Tapp | Boise Shooting Range Scroll Double Tapp Range is a PRIVATE range and not open to the general public. We are members only. Guests may be brought out by active range members at a cost of $10 per guest, per day. Guest fees will be going up to $15 per guest per day beginning January 1st 2025. Our memberships are currently capped, and we have over 100 people on our membership waitlist. We are not taking any additions to our waitlist until we have new ranges done and space available. Overbooking the range would be detrimental to the experience enjoyed by our members. Please check back during the Spring of 2025.UPCOMING TRAINING: Our next Pistol & Personal Safety Classroom session will be as follows:Date: Pending Time: PendingLocation: Pending You can always schedule a private range session anytime! Our range sessions are all PRIVATE with just you and your family/friends. We are currently signing up people for the PRIVATE half day range training sessions. We have dates available now. Please click here for more information or email mark@doubletappboise.com to schedule a private range training session. Welcome to Double Tapp Range (DTR). DTR is one of the finest private firearm ranges in Idaho. This is a 160 acre MEMBERS ONLY facility, located just 16 miles east of Boise, just off of I-84 at exit 71. Click the link at the bottom of the page to bring up a map of our location. DTR is in a constant state of growth and refinement. Tremendous growth has been taking place at DTR every year and we are on track to be the best private range in the Pacific Northwest within a few years. We offer range membership, a multitude of training opportunities, FFL transfers, and more. Click on any of the menu selections above for additional information. Mark has spent a lifetime working for law enforcement agencies and has amassed a significant level in experience that he looks forward to sharing with you. DTR has a presence on social media. Icons at the top left of any page are directed to our accounts. If you have any questions, the bottom of any page, click on “Email Mark” to send a message and we will do our best to get back to you promptly!We currently have 6 ranges available for member use, and 7 more under construction. Many of our ranges have cement pads and shade covers overhead for protection from the elements. Range #1 is a 50 yards deep by 50 yards wide. It is primarily a pistol range. Range #1 is equipped with a very nice enclosed building right behind the firing line. This provides the shooter with protection from the elements, and makes for a more comfortable shooting experience regardless of the time of year. This range has 24 lanes and a very nice sand covered range surface. This range is the primary range for member use, though members can use any of the other ranges as well, as they are available. The 100 yard range is equipped with very nice, custom built, steel shooting tables that are very heavy and bolted to the ground. We have two modern vault toilet systems, which are odorless and very nice. We work hard to keep these restrooms clean and well maintained. We get more compliments on our restrooms than anything else! The range is always open during daylight hours, 365 days a year, with rare exceptions for range maintenance or safety considerations. The gate will either be standing open, or closed but unlocked. The gate on the west side of our property leads out onto thousands of acres of BLM property. It is locked at all times, but members can utilize that gate, for easy access to the BLM ground out in that direction. There are many target stands and sticks on all ranges. We have a large number of cardboard backers located in the buildings on range. Just bring your paper targets and a stapler! We just ask that members bring cardboard backers back into the building when not in use, as the wind and moisture can completely destroys them over night. Members are free to use any of the ranges on site, with the exception of the Law Enforcement ranges which are signed and gated. Members always have access to Range 1 (enclosed building with roll-up doors). On the weekends, instructors can book the other ranges, but we've never seen all ranges being used at the same time. During the week its generally very light usage, making it perfect for retired people, shift workers, or others with free time mid-week.

**Double Tapp Range and Firearms Training: A Private Oasis for Idaho Gun Enthusiasts**

In the heart of Boise, nestled in a quiet corner of the Treasure Valley, lies Double Tapp Range - a private haven for firearms enthusiasts who demand the best training facilities and expert guidance. Our members-only range provides an exclusive environment where gun owners can hone their skills with confidence, knowing they're among like-minded individuals who share a passion for responsible shooting practices.

Our expert instructors are well-versed in providing top-notch firearm instruction, tailored to meet the needs of hunters, sport shooters, and concealed carry permit holders alike. From basic handgun safety courses to advanced rifle training sessions, our programs cater to all skill levels, emphasizing proper technique, firearms handling, and safe usage. With access to state-of-the-art equipment and expert advice from seasoned professionals, Double Tapp Range is your go-to destination for firearms education and training in Idaho's growing outdoor community.

Whether you're an avid hunter looking to improve your marksmanship or a newcomer seeking comprehensive firearm training, our private range offers an unparalleled level of service, exclusivity, and personalized attention that truly sets us apart. Experience the difference that comes with being part of Idaho's most discerning shooting community - join us at Double Tapp Range today!

ai_content.description:
The Treasure Valley's premier shotgun-only facility for trap and skeet enthusiasts is just off Kuna-Mora Road, where you'll find the Boise Gun Club Trap & Skeet. This 501(c)4 non-profit organization pours all its profits back into maintaining and improving the shooting grounds, ensuring every visit is an exceptional experience.

Expert gun owners know that precision and patience are key to mastering firearms skills – a lesson the Boise Gun Club emphasizes through their public leagues and training programs. Whether you're looking to improve your aim or simply enjoy some friendly competition with fellow shooters, this club offers an unparalleled environment for honing your craft in Idaho's scenic countryside. With regular operating hours year-round on Wednesdays (12pm-8pm), Sundays during winter months (12pm-5pm) and summer seasons (10am-4pm), Saturdays only during summers (10am-4pm), members can rely on the facility being available when they need it most.
